name: DUT-OMRON: Salient Object Detection Dataset
description: DUT-OMRON is a prominent salient object detection benchmark consisting of 5,168 natural images manually selected from more than 140,000 photos, each with pixel-level ground truth masks and bounding box annotations from 5 human annotators.

publisher.name: Dalian University of Technology & OMRON Corporation

source_references.title: Saliency Detection via Graph-Based Manifold Ranking
How far we away from a perfect visual saliency detection - DUT-OMRON: a new benchmark dataset
source_references.notes: Published in 20th Korea-Japan Joint Workshop on Frontiers of Computer Vision (FCV 2014), DOI: 10.1109/FCV.2014.6787948.

verification.notes: Verified against CVPR 2013 paper (DOI: 10.1109/CVPR.2013.407), FCV 2014 benchmark paper (DOI: 10.1109/FCV.2014.6787948), and official benchmark archive. Exactly 5,168 natural images with 5 annotator bounding boxes and eye-fixations. A 2018 update to the archive noted 4 images lacked pixel-wise ground-truth masks (leaving 5,164 pixel masks and 5,168 eye-fixations/bounding boxes).

size.notes: JPEG source images and PNG pixel ground-truth masks.
